adjudication.hostile_control: A planted false positive into a family with perfect recall must reduce that family's F1 below recall.
adjudication.procedure: Recompute one-vs-rest TP/FP/FN for every hidden-cause family directly from immutable results.jsonl and suite gold; derive precision, recall and F1; preserve report.json unchanged.

authority.note: Metric repair does not change raw labels, 21/24 accuracy, residual errors, or authorize self-improvement/fresh-transfer claims.

differing_fields.root_cause: report.json per-family f1 copied recall and ignored false positives into a family

identity_migration.preserved_unchanged_means: The historical aggregate was never altered or re-run: the metrics object is byte-identical across the R0 rename. Only the file's own results_path/suite_path strings moved, which is why its whole-file digest changed while the recorded result did not.
identity_migration.reason: R0 namespace unification renamed the containing paper directory; the two internal path fields were rewritten with it.
